products.name: ZooWork
products.tagline: The AI agent delivery platform for FDEs and domain experts
products.description: ZooWork lets you build, deploy, and deliver AI agents to teams or clients — experts start in the Builder UI, developers ship with the Managed Agent API. Turn your expertise into AI solutions built for real business operations.

products.name: miso.com
products.tagline: Book flights and hotels through iMessage
products.description: Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

products.name: Prefer
products.description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

products.name: Muse Gadgets
products.tagline: Meta's open-source kit for building your own AI gadgets
products.description: Muse Gadgets is Meta's open-source hardware toolkit for bringing Muse into the physical world. Connect an ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or Linux device to displays, microphones, speakers, buttons, sensors, and more, then let Muse interact through the hardware you build. Make a pocket AI companion, e-ink briefing display, smart-home controller, TV interface, or something entirely your own. SDKs and firmware are open source under Apache 2.0.

products.name: Kindle 2026
products.tagline: A smaller, faster Kindle with a flush-front display
products.description: Kindle 2026 is Amazon’s redesigned 6-inch e-reader, now smaller and lighter with 30% faster book opening and a flush-front display. It also comes in a new 32GB aluminum version for the first time.

products.name: Cubicle
products.tagline: A live office for your AI agents, read-only by design
products.description: Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Paperclip agents work in a live office: they sit down and type, raise a hand or line up at your desk when they need you, and go to the lounge when done. KPI board for your tasks, Telegram alerts with the agent's questions, phone view, pixel or HD themes, real faces, your logo. One command (npx), zero dependencies, MIT. Read-only by design: it only watches; the one optional write is your own Telegram reply, posted as a comment.

products.name: FoundrRadio
products.tagline: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air
products.description: FoundrRadio is an internet radio platform where founders could own their own radio stations and go on air. Visitors could listen to their favourite founders, their talks or music they love. An opportunity to own a small corner on the internet. An attempt to combine nostalgia and community.

products.name: SCMD
products.tagline: Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory.
products.description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

products.name: FeelMyMac
products.tagline: Lets you feel different textures through your Mac’s trackpad
products.description: FeelMyMac brings haptic textures to cursor movement and scrolling on Mac trackpads. Instead of feeling feedback only when you click, you can actually feel simulated surfaces as you move your cursor, with different materials and textures to choose from. You can enable haptics separately for cursor customize intensity, and add optional sound effects. FeelMyMac also includes keyboard sounds for an extra layer of feedback. How it works? Easy it's Taptic Engine just like an iPhone would!

products.name: eu/jev
products.tagline: The first Jev-like model hosted in the EU
products.description: If you want to try System One models like Jev for work, but can't because of GDPR and data sovereignty issues, eu/jev is for you; it's the first System One model hosted in the EU, running on our Hetzner GPUs in Germany. It's fully GDPR compliant and we don't save any prompts/answers. You can call it exactly the way you'd call Jev, at the exact same pricing as Jev (which means free output tokens!). Built on Winnow, the #1 open-source System One model on JevBench.

products.name: Notchware
products.tagline: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch
products.description: That notch at the top of your MacBook does nothing. Notchware turns it into a live island: Now Playing with artwork and playback controls, plus battery, volume, brightness, Focus, and Wi-Fi status right where you look. Notchware Pro ($3.99 one-time) adds Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor alerts, so you know the moment an agent needs approval or finishes, without watching the terminal. Native SwiftUI. No account, no analytics, no cloud. macOS 14.6+.

products.name: MacCam
products.tagline: The camera app Apple never shipped for the Mac
products.description: MacCam is a free, native camera app for macOS. Take photos and videos with your Mac's camera, iPhone or any webcam - straight into Apple Photos. Classic Photo Booth effects plus Portrait, Studio Light and Edge Light built in. Coming to Pro: a teleprompter, eye contact and knock to shoot - free for life for the first 100,000.

products.name: WattMate
products.tagline: Which app is draining your Mac, in watts and minutes saved
products.description: WattMate sits in the Mac menu bar and shows which app is draining the battery right now, in watts, and how many minutes you get back if you quit it. 2 minutes after you quit, it measures again and prints what really changed. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

products.name: una mano
products.tagline: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb
products.description: una mano moves a familiar QWERTY keyboard left, centre, or right when a hand is busy. Use the Position control or swipe to move it. Plus adds optional Motion Switch. Core typing works without Full Access. New installs get 14 days of Plus; no plan is selected.

products.name: Deskcord.chat
products.tagline: A widget to chat with customers from your Discord server
products.description: Turn Discord into your support desk and chat with your customers. Embed our chat widget in 5 minutes and let your customers reach out to you directly to your server. Every conversation in the widget becomes a Discord thread. Unlimited seats, unlimited domains. Deskcord is built for solo founders and small teams. Skip the bloated and expensive tools and get closer to your customers from the comfort of your Discord server. Deskcord is an alternative to the giants like Intercom, Crisp or Zendesk.
